verdict.rationale: Homebrew can be pointed at additional package sources through `brew tap`, which adds repositories for formulae, casks and external commands by cloning a git repo. A community user confirms hosting a self-run tap is possible, though harder than apt/yum because it needs a git server rather than a static host. Nothing in the evidence covers mirror configuration or any authentication, scoped or otherwise, for private sources. Missing for 10: documented mirror/registry override configuration, scoped or per-source authentication (tokens/credentials), and independent corroboration of private-tap auth workflows.
